methodology: One discarded production build per panel, then five measured builds each, sequentially in rotating order. Full package-manager production build command, including upstream clean, SDK generation and postbuild checks. Dependencies installed from unmodified lockfiles before timing with install lifecycle scripts disabled. Each sample starts a fresh CLI process; filesystem/dependency caches remain warm. All checkouts reside on the same Linux named volume in one four-CPU, 8 GiB builder. Total assets cover all manifest-emitted JavaScript and CSS routes; they are not dashboard HTTP transfer sizes. Per-file gzip level 6. Dependency installation, PHP image builds and artifact analysis are excluded.
